rule: Baseline must be an existing historical observation or an observation captured at the Decision/Execution boundary, preserving original timestamp and provenance.
notAllowed: latest current KPI used retroactively as the old baseline

cases.O: baseline at 2026-01-01 + linked actual at 2026-04-01 → CORE-OUT:1 comparison-ready
cases.P: linked actual without baseline → actual observed, comparison incomplete
cases.retroactiveKpi: observation after window.openedAt cannot become baseline
